scope: Standalone lossless GPU transfer codec: all 28 layers use our Dense or Rank256 predictor/rANS. The candidate changes only fixed-CDF inversion; complete original packets, fitted coefficients, prediction arithmetic and BF16 words stay fixed. SplitZip and ExANS are separate unchanged controls, not candidate components. Existing compact-search graph execution at 512 tokens and direct-search execution at 8192 tokens are retained. These two documents are reused engineering evidence, not independent generalization. Link costs are calculated, not NIC/SSD, resident P or serving measurements.
